_about: Who wrote each shown text (tools/hangar_text.py; the hangar's Text tab). signed: a slot's id -> by ("ryan": Ryan wrote it, the corpus docs/voice.md is drawn from; "ok": a session's draft he accepted as it stands), text (as he signed it), mech (the mechanics it described then) and on (the day). A slot not named here is a draft. Written by the fold alone, from his marks on the page: a session never signs a text for him, and one that changes a signed text leaves the signature as it is, so the page shows him the change.
